check('simple', lambda: top_words("b a b c a b", 2), [('b', 3), ('a', 2)])
check('case folded', lambda: top_words("A a B", 1), [('a', 2)])
check('ties alphabetical', lambda: top_words("z y x", 2), [('x', 1), ('y', 1)])
check('empty', lambda: top_words("", 3), [])
check('n larger', lambda: top_words("a", 5), [('a', 1)])
check('n zero', lambda: top_words("a b", 0), [])

check('classic', lambda: group_anagrams(["eat", "tea", "tan", "ate", "nat", "bat"]), [['eat', 'tea', 'ate'], ['tan', 'nat'], ['bat']])
check('empty', lambda: group_anagrams([]), [])
check('one', lambda: group_anagrams(["a"]), [['a']])
check('empty string', lambda: group_anagrams(["", ""]), [['', '']])
check('duplicates kept', lambda: group_anagrams(["ab", "ba", "ab"]), [['ab', 'ba', 'ab']])
check('none match', lambda: group_anagrams(["ab", "cd"]), [['ab'], ['cd']])

check('k=3', lambda: moving_average([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], 3), [1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0])
check('k=1', lambda: moving_average([4, 8], 1), [4.0, 8.0])
check('empty', lambda: moving_average([], 2), [])
check('k larger than input', lambda: moving_average([2, 4], 5), [2.0, 3.0])
check('floats', lambda: moving_average([0.1, 0.2, 0.3], 2), [0.1, 0.15, 0.25])
check('negatives', lambda: moving_average([-2, 2, -2], 2), [-2.0, 0.0, 0.0])

check('classic sequence', lambda: (lambda c: [c.put(1, 1), c.put(2, 2), c.get(1), c.put(3, 3), c.get(2), c.put(4, 4), c.get(1), c.get(3), c.get(4)])(LRUCache(2)), [None, None, 1, None, -1, None, -1, 3, 4])
check('miss', lambda: LRUCache(1).get(9), -1)
check('update keeps size', lambda: (lambda c: [c.put(1, 1), c.put(1, 5), c.get(1), len(c.data)])(LRUCache(2)), [None, None, 5, 1])
check('capacity one', lambda: (lambda c: [c.put(1, 1), c.put(2, 2), c.get(1), c.get(2)])(LRUCache(1)), [None, None, -1, 2])
check('get refreshes recency', lambda: (lambda c: [c.put(1, 1), c.put(2, 2), c.get(1), c.put(3, 3), c.get(1), c.get(2)])(LRUCache(2)), [None, None, 1, None, 1, -1])
check('put refreshes recency', lambda: (lambda c: [c.put(1, 1), c.put(2, 2), c.put(1, 10), c.put(3, 3), c.get(2), c.get(1)])(LRUCache(2)), [None, None, None, None, -1, 10])

check('classic', lambda: kth_largest([3, 2, 1, 5, 6, 4], 2), 5)
check('duplicates count', lambda: kth_largest([3, 2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 5, 5, 6], 4), 4)
check('k=1', lambda: kth_largest([7], 1), 7)
check('negatives', lambda: kth_largest([-1, -5, -3], 2), -3)
check('k equals length', lambda: kth_largest([4, 1, 9], 3), 1)
check('floats', lambda: kth_largest([0.5, 2.5, 1.5], 1), 2.5)

check('three lists', lambda: merge_sorted([[1, 4, 9], [2, 3, 10], [5]]), [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 9, 10])
check('empty', lambda: merge_sorted([]), [])
check('empty partitions', lambda: merge_sorted([[], [1], []]), [1])
check('duplicates', lambda: merge_sorted([[1, 1], [1]]), [1, 1, 1])
check('strings', lambda: merge_sorted([["a", "c"], ["b"]]), ['a', 'b', 'c'])
check('single', lambda: merge_sorted([[3, 4]]), [3, 4])

check('classic', lambda: min_rooms([(0, 30), (5, 10), (15, 20)]), 2)
check('no overlap', lambda: min_rooms([(7, 10), (2, 4)]), 1)
check('empty', lambda: min_rooms([]), 0)
check('back to back', lambda: min_rooms([(1, 5), (5, 10)]), 1)
check('all overlap', lambda: min_rooms([(1, 10), (2, 9), (3, 8)]), 3)
check('unsorted input', lambda: min_rooms([(5, 8), (1, 6), (6, 7)]), 2)

check('small', lambda: tier(30), 'small')
check('boundary is the next tier', lambda: tier(100), 'medium')
check('just below', lambda: tier(499.99), 'medium')
check('large', lambda: tier(999), 'large')
check('enterprise', lambda: tier(1180), 'enterprise')
check('negative', lambda: tier(-5), 'small')

check('inside', lambda: count_between([1, 3, 3, 5, 8], 3, 5), 3)
check('none', lambda: count_between([1, 2], 5, 9), 0)
check('empty', lambda: count_between([], 0, 10), 0)
check('all', lambda: count_between([1, 2, 3], 0, 10), 3)
check('inverted range', lambda: count_between([1, 2], 3, 1), 0)
check('single point', lambda: count_between([2, 2, 2], 2, 2), 3)

check('classic', lambda: first_unique("leetcode"), 0)
check('later', lambda: first_unique("loveleetcode"), 2)
check('none', lambda: first_unique("aabb"), -1)
check('empty', lambda: first_unique(""), -1)
check('single', lambda: first_unique("z"), 0)
check('case sensitive', lambda: first_unique("aA"), 0)

check('two levels', lambda: totals([("n", "d1", 10), ("n", "d1", 5), ("s", "d2", 7)]), {'n': {'d1': 15}, 's': {'d2': 7}})
check('empty', lambda: totals([]), {})
check('plain dicts returned', lambda: type(totals([("n", "d", 1)])["n"]).__name__, 'dict')
check('several days', lambda: totals([("n", "d1", 1), ("n", "d2", 2)]), {'n': {'d1': 1, 'd2': 2}})
check('negative amounts', lambda: totals([("n", "d", 5), ("n", "d", -5)]), {'n': {'d': 0}})
check('floats', lambda: totals([("x", "d", 0.5), ("x", "d", 0.25)]), {'x': {'d': 0.75}})

check('two rows', lambda: to_records(["id", "name"], [[1, "a"], [2, "b"]]), [{'id': 1, 'name': 'a'}, {'id': 2, 'name': 'b'}])
check('no rows', lambda: to_records(["id"], []), [])
check('one field', lambda: to_records(["x"], [[None]]), [{'x': None}])
check('field order kept', lambda: list(to_records(["b", "a"], [[1, 2]])[0]), ['b', 'a'])
check('wrong width raises', lambda: raises(lambda: to_records(["a", "b"], [[1]]), TypeError), True)
check('invalid field name raises', lambda: raises(lambda: to_records(["order id"], [[1]]), ValueError), True)

check('precedence', lambda: resolve({"a": 1, "b": 1, "c": 1}, {"b": 2, "c": 2}, {"c": 3}), {'a': 1, 'b': 2, 'c': 3})
check('None does not override', lambda: resolve({"t": 30}, {"t": None}, {}), {'t': 30})
check('all empty', lambda: resolve({}, {}, {}), {})
check('new key from cli', lambda: resolve({}, {}, {"x": 1}), {'x': 1})
check('falsy but set', lambda: resolve({"d": True}, {}, {"d": False}), {'d': False})
check('defaults untouched', lambda: (lambda d: (resolve(d, {"a": 2}, {}), d)[1])({"a": 1}), {'a': 1})
